name: select_evolution_artifact
description: Compare no-change, Knowledge, Skill, Identity/sub-Agent and Harness candidates using explicit reuse benefit, token saving, implementation cost, maintenance cost, confidence and regression risk. Use when more than one evolution response is plausible; the result is advisory and auditable, not an automatic mutation.

candidates.description: Candidate artifacts including a kind and normalized 0..1 estimates. Include kind=none so no-change is considered.

minimum_utility.description: Minimum positive utility needed to prefer mutation over no-change; default 0.08.
